policy.first_guess: New atomic/Harris guess; U singlets may use fresh Guess=Mix; no original checkpoint
stages: fresh Opt+Freq or fixed-geometry Force or atomic SP
if instability found: reoptimize and recompute frequencies (or Force/SP at fixed geometry), then recheck stability
policy.scf_retry: Only declared SCF convergence failures; extend XQC from 1024 to 2048 cycles
policy.terminal_result: candidate_collected or explicit failure; never automatic scientific pass
policy.physical_review: All primary candidates collected before review; competing states, environments and other methods remain required when applicable
